evals.prompt: Draft only; do not open GitHub. Prepare a PR body for a bug fix that closes #42. The change reuses the payment selector's default-selection helper to prevent signup checkout from disabling the CTA when a merchant has an ineligible bank account and an eligible card. This is not stacked. Manual Tophat has not run; suggest author-owned setup and binary cases.
evals.expected_output: A concise PR body with Closes #42, a minimally sufficient Summary, paragraph-form Context, no callout, no Stack section, and an explicitly unrun author-owned Tophat plan.
assertions: A Closes #42 directive appears before Summary
Summary opens with a bold bug-fix-labeled paragraph of at most 3 sentences and 60 words, followed by one-fact bullets
Every Summary bullet is a one-liner fragment of at most 12 words with no terminal period, no subordinate clause, and no rationale
Context is a 1-3 sentence paragraph under 80 words explaining customer impact and why the shared helper is needed
No GitHub alert callout is used, because nothing blocks approval or merge
Stack is omitted
Tophat suggests setup and mixed bank/card binary cases without claiming they ran

evals.prompt: Draft only; do not open GitHub. Prepare the middle PR description in a three-PR deprecation stack: #100 stops new writes, this branch backfills existing rows, and #102 removes the legacy column. The project is reducing dual-write operational risk. Manual Tophat is complex and author-owned; suggest setup, before/after checks, and cleanup.
evals.expected_output: A concise deprecation PR body ordered Summary, Context, Tophat, Stack, whose Stack section is a bare map of all three changes in merge order with this PR highlighted.
assertions: Summary opens with a bold deprecation-labeled paragraph of at most 3 sentences and 60 words, followed by one-fact bullets
No bullet anywhere in the body is a full sentence or carries a because/so-that clause; each is a fragment of at most 12 words
Context is a 1-3 sentence paragraph under 80 words explaining the project motivation
Sections appear in the order Summary, Context, Tophat, Stack
Stack lists #100, this PR, and #102 in merge order with this PR bolded
Stack contains no prose narrating sequencing, coupling, or why the stack is shaped this way
Neither Context nor Stack explains the dual-write sequencing beyond naming the shared goal once
Tophat provides author-facing setup, before/after checks, and cleanup suggestions without claiming completion

evals.prompt: Draft only; do not open GitHub. This is a tiny top-of-stack maintenance PR: remove the single ignored_columns entry for legacy_flag after #20 drops the physical column. No other code changes. It must deploy only after #20's migration completes. The stack is #18 remove the backend field, #19 resync the client schema, #20 drop the column, then this PR. Manual Tophat has not run; suggest an author-owned model-load smoke test.
evals.expected_output: A minimal maintenance PR body led by a single WARNING callout about the deploy-order dependency, then a one-bullet Summary, a one-sentence Context, an author-owned Tophat, and a terse four-row Stack map.
assertions: Exactly one callout appears, before Summary, typed WARNING because deploying ahead of #20's migration breaks model loading
The callout states the action rather than explaining the reasoning, and is not restated in Context or Stack
Summary's paragraph labels the change as maintenance, and its single bullet is a fragment naming the removed ignored_columns entry without explaining it

Stack lists #18, #19, #20, and this PR in order with this PR bolded, using the table form and host-read Status values
Stack contains no prose about the migration ordering
Tophat uses numbered steps for the linear model-load smoke test without claiming it ran

evals.prompt: Draft only; do not open GitHub. This feature emits per-wallet ready metrics on two routes with different expectations: Admin `/admin/checkout` emits ReadyResult plus ReadyDuration, while Signup `/signup/checkout` emits ReadyResult only. A dev-only monkey patch controls Apple Pay and Google Pay independently with show, timeout, or hide URL parameters and must be removed before commit or push. Manual Tophat has not run. Suggest author-owned coverage for both-ready, both-timeout, mixed ready/timeout, and hidden cases. Visual console evidence and a recording of the mixed timing flow would help reviewers.
evals.expected_output: A concise PR body whose Tophat separates Admin and Signup because their routes and expectations differ, uses compact case/parameter/expected-result tables, and includes concrete unchecked screenshot and recording prompts plus monkey-patch cleanup.
assertions: Tophat uses separate Admin and Signup subheadings because their routes and expected emissions differ
Repeated wallet-state cases use Markdown tables with Case and Expected plus compact setup or per-input parameter columns
The tables cover both-ready, both-timeout, mixed ready/timeout, and relevant hidden cases
Tophat includes the exact prefix `- [ ] Screenshot:` with a concrete filtered-console hint
Tophat includes the exact prefix `- [ ] Recording:` with a concrete mixed ready/timeout hint
Tophat removes the dev-only monkey patch before commit or push
Media prompts are author-owned and do not claim evidence was already captured

evals.prompt: Draft only; do not open GitHub. Prepare a PR body for a bug fix in a two-PR stack. #500 is open and adds a shared `QUERY_PARAMS` constant; this PR makes the reopen page honour the merchant's chosen plan. Two things are outstanding: this branch must be rebased once #500 merges, and it then needs two params added to that constant or the pricing goes stale. I already investigated why the quote cannot price a period switch on its own, and why the sanitizer boundary is unchanged — both are written up on the issue. Manual Tophat has not run.
evals.expected_output: A PR body with exactly one IMPORTANT callout carrying the two blocking steps, a tight Summary, a short Context, an author-owned Tophat, and a two-item Stack with no sequencing prose.
assertions: Exactly one callout appears, before Summary, typed IMPORTANT because the PR must not be merged as-is
The callout lists the rebase and the two-param follow-up as short outstanding steps and states no rationale
No second callout appears anywhere in the body
No NOTE, TIP, or CAUTION callout is used
Context does not retell the quote-pricing investigation or the sanitizer-boundary reasoning, and links or defers to the issue instead
Sections appear in the order Summary, Context, Tophat, Stack
Stack is a two-item list naming #500 and this PR with no paragraph explaining the overlap, prerequisite, or follow-up
Tophat is presented as author-owned suggestions without claiming any run happened
